name: Hellevator
source:
Once upon a time, there was a building. And in that building, there was an elevator. And in that elevator, there was…

---

A group of strangers are trapped inside an elevator. What seems to be a normal day quickly turns into a tumultuous one as superstitions go out of control and the Devil starts murdering these strangers one by one. But is there really a supernatural entity out to kill them?

Based on the movie “The Devil” (2010), written by M. Night Shyamalan and Brian Nelson, we intend to mimic the story premise while giving it a twist of our own.

[From [url=https://abyss-team.itch.io/hellevator]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
从前，有一栋大楼。大楼里，有一部电梯。电梯里，有……

——

一群素不相识的人被困在电梯中。迷信与恐慌逐渐失控，恶魔开始将这些陌生人逐一杀害，原本平凡的一天，转眼变得动荡不安。但真的有什么超自然存在，想要杀死他们吗？

本作以M·奈特·沙马兰与布莱恩·尼尔森编剧的2010年电影《电梯里的恶魔》为基础，沿用其故事前提，并加入我们自己的变化。

[摘自[url=https://abyss-team.itch.io/hellevator]itch.io[/url]]
